name: Gathering Winds
notes:
Proposed numbers: the max stays 5 stacks at every level. +20% at level 5 matches vanilla Rhythm's top attack speed (ran_rhythm, 0.2).

In game (hwp_ran_gathering_winds, tested): every 5 kills by the ranger add a Tailwind stack, up to 5, each ending 4 s after its own kill; the speed is the tailwind_<level>_<stacks> buff.
summary: Every 5 kills grants a stack of Tailwind for 4s, up to 5 stacks. Each stack increases your Action Speed (Movement, Skill and Weapon Speed) by 2%.
